repo_notes.content: ashlr-plugin is a multi-host coding-agent efficiency layer. Use README.md, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and site/content/docs/ as the public documentation; docs/ contains contributor notes unless linked from a public page. Ground descriptions in the current source and avoid inventing benchmark results.

The MCP router and tool implementations live in servers/; CLI entry points live in scripts/; hooks/, commands/, agents/, skills/, and ports/ provide host integrations. server/, site/, and vscode/ are distinct supporting applications.

ashlr-plugin is the efficiency layer of the Ashlr ecosystem. Phantom (github.com/ashlrai/phantom) and its sibling repos (phantom-secrets, ashlr-plugin, locus, lexicon, ashlr-md, ashlr-stack) form an autonomous, code-first, agent-native software factory: agents do the engineering and maintain each repo, the human sits as a passive board member, and the goal is open source RSI (recursive self-improvement). Describe the sibling repos only as the README section 'Part of the Ashlr ecosystem' does. Most PRs here are opened by coding agents under AGENTS.md; CONTRIBUTING.md and site/content/docs/contributing/index.mdx describe that workflow. Phantom and other agents discover the plugin through `ashlr-plugin --ashlr-handshake` (docs/ashlr-handshake.md).
